The *Dhammātherīgāthā* (Thig 1.17) is a short verse text preserved in the *Therīgāthā* (*Verses of the Elder Nuns*), belonging to the Khuddaka Nikāya of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. It records the verses attributed to the awakened nun (*therī*) Dhammā. The text is preserved across multiple lineages of the Pali tradition and is represented on SuttaCentral in eighteen translations across thirteen languages, including modern English translations by Ayya Soma and Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
